title: Hauling up into a stand by about 1 year
summary: Most children pull up to stand by about 1 year.
body: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 1-year movement lines include pulls up to stand. Arms haul the body from the floor into an upright posture. That haul is the whole claim. The page groups it with what most children do by one year. A haul that comes later is not graded here. National lists elsewhere can choose another age. The torso comes up off the floor by a haul, which is the one-year posture item. The torso rises off the floor by haul, which is the one-year posture item.
